title: Floral carpet (dark blue ground), late 18th/early 19th century, Azerbaijan
notes: Floral carpet (dark blue ground), late 18th/early 19th century, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum, Istanbul. inv. no 835 (3-364) from the Evkaf Depot, Samsun, Turkey. 160 x 320 cm. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 97. Alternating sequence of dark yellow and red stylized palmettes and pale yellow octagonal rosettes.
